sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'Friday'
    WHEN
      CAST(strftime('%w', published_at) AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN 'Saturday'
  END AS day_of_week,
  COUNT(*) AS num_listings
FROM
  fct_posting
WHERE
  remote_us = TRUE AND is_open = TRUE AND is_canonical_listing = TRUE
GROUP BY
  day_of_week
ORDER BY
  num_listings DESC
LIMIT 1
